experiment: Exploratory frozen allocator geometry diagnostic; not optimization performance
state_policy: 16 iid U([0,1]^D) archive representatives, unit archive radii, no working or terminal memory, unchanged mature-state proposal
candidate_policy: Original D^2 per source; full=D^2 uniform+D^2 relations, no_relations=2D^2 uniform; identical first D^2 uniform points
radius_policy: All normTabDis=1: source score equals nearest Euclidean clearance. This common scale cannot alter within-state ranking.
measurement_policy: Clipping is inferred from exact 0/1 coordinates after source np.clip (equivalent almost surely for continuous iid states/directions). Contrast=(max reference distance-min reference distance)/mean reference distance, averaged over uniform candidates. Clearance divided by sqrt(D) only in reporting.
timing_policy: Single original propose call per seed/control, alternating order; one warmup per dimension; diagnostics excluded; wall times hardware/load dependent, descriptive only
statistics_policy: All 120 paired trials retained. Means and descriptive 95% Student-t CIs across 20 paired seeds; no significance screening or optional stopping; medians for wall time.
scope: Fixed synthetic archive geometry only, not actual optimization trajectories, basin coverage, target recovery, or convergence; 16-representative policy does not assess memory-cardinality scaling.
